card.name: First digit of day in dates
card.fires_on: The first digit of a two-digit day number (1 or 2) inside a written date, such as 06-<<2>>0-2011 or June <<1>>6, 2010. It appears mostly in dated news lists and archives.

modes.label: Numeric dates
modes.description: The tens digit of the day in MM-DD-YYYY style dates in news link lists.
modes.example: - 06-30-2011: Lawsuit Against Netflix Exposes Need for Closed Captioning - 06-<<2>>0-2011: CO

modes.label: Written-out dates
modes.description: The tens digit of the day after a month name, or in a slash date.
modes.example: to write the Dakota Language June 24, 2010 Minn. companies helped fight WWII in surprising ways June <<1>>6, 2010

card.plain: It marks the first digit of a day number in a date, such as the 1 in 16 or the 2 in 20.
